title: Oratorial
summary: ORATO'RIAL, ORATO'RIALLY, ORATOR'ICAL, adjective Pertaining to an orator or to oratory; rhetorical; becoming an orator. We say, a man has many oratorical flourishes, or he speaks in an oratorical way.
